chunks: The morning when it is unveiled,

key_terms.أَسْفَرَ: Unveiled, brightened, or turned yellowish-white (indicating the spread of light)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'The morning when it is unveiled' mean in Surah Al-Muddaththir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the dawn of prophethood or the emergence of Imam Ali (AS) as the bearer of divine clarity, symbolizing the transition from the darkness of ignorance to the light of guidance. The term 'asfara' (brightening) is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as a metaphor for the spreading of truth and the establishment of justice, reinforcing the concept of divine illumination (nur) in the spiritual journey of the faithful.
